items.name: Caneletto, Pinot Nior
items.description: A light, elegant Italian red with cherry and raspberry flavors. Smooth & easy-drinking, perfect for new wine lovers. Pairs well with Margherita pizza, Fettuccine Alfredo with chicken, & Pollo alla Griglia.

items.name: Michele Chiarlo Le Orme, Barbera D’Asti
items.description: Well-structured Barbera with notes of cherry & red currants with a savory finish. Pairs well with Spaghetti Bolognese & any of our famous pizzas.

items.name: Globerati, Sangiovese
items.description: A lively red with juicy cherry & plum flavors, plus a hint of spice. A smooth & easygoing Italian staple. Pairs well with any of our pizzas, Spaghettini Ortolano, & Fedelini Pachino.

items.name: Mandola, Chianti Riserva
items.description: One of Trina Mandola’s favorite wines & it is exclusively from the Hills of Tuscany in Chianti. This full-bodied red wine pairs well with heartier dishes like our Beef Brasato, Lasagne, Gnocchi Bolognese, & Chicken Parmesan.

items.name: Mandola, Montepulciano
items.description: Damian Mandola’s favorite red wine! It pairs well with everything from Spaghetti & Meatballs to Pizza.

items.name: Candoni, Merlot
items.description: Organically grown grapes that come from the unspoiled vineyards located in the Sicily region. The result is a mellow & balanced wine with notes of blueberry, red fruit, & vanilla. Pairs well with Eggplant Parmesan, Lasagne, Fried Mozzarella, & our Caprese Salad.

items.name: Mandola, Cabernet Sauvignon
items.description: Dark cherry, tobacco, cedar and red currant that pairs perfectly with pork, veal, & lamb.

items.name: Bonanza, Cabernet Sauvignon
items.description: A selection from California’s Caymus family, this wine is elegant, smooth, & rich with dark cherry notes. It’s easy-drinking with a soft, lingering finish. Pairs well with our Lasagne, Pollo alla Griglia, Chicken Parmesan, Beef Brasato, & Bolognese.

items.name: Frozen Peach Bellini
items.description: A fruity blend of pureed peaches & sparkling white wine.

items.name: Frozen Sangria
items.description: Red wine, fresh orange juice, & a dash of cinnamon.

items.name: Mandola, Pinot Grigio
items.description: A crisp refreshing white wine with green apple, citrus, & pear flavors. Light-bodied with a clean finish, it’s perfect for easy drinking. Pairs well with our Shrimp Scampi, Caprese Salad, Bruschetta, & Salmon Cefalu.

items.name: Bollini, Sauvignon Blanc
items.description: A bright, zesty white wine with green apple, citrus, & pear flavors. Light-bodied with a clean finish, it’s perfect for new wine drinkers. Pairs well with our Shrimp, Chicken Piccata, Caprese Salad, & Grilled Vegetables.

items.name: Villa Sparina, Gavi
items.description: A crisp, elegant white wine with green apples, citrus, & a touch of almond. Light & refreshing, it’s pairs perfectly with Shrimp, Grilled Salmon, Pesto Pasta, & our Caprese Panino.

items.name: Dipinti, Chardonnay
items.description: A smooth, medium-bodied white wine with ripe apple, pear, & a touch of vanilla. It’s balanced & approachable. Great with Alfredo sauce, Pollo alla Griglia, Shrimp, Roasted Vegetables.

items.name: Prosecco, Avissi
items.description: A crisp, bubbly wine with flavors of green apple, pear, & citrus. Light & refreshing, it’s great for any occasion. Pairs well with Bruschetta, Shrimp, Fedelini Pachino, Parma Pizza, Prosciutto, & Fried Mozzarella.

items.name: La Vielle Ferme, Brut Rosé
items.description: A crisp, bubbly rosé with flavors of red berries, citrus, & subtle floral notes. Light & refreshing, it pairs well with all of our fresh Salads, Shrimp, Salmon, Light Pasta, Bruschetta, & Prosciutto.

items.name: La Perlina, Moscato
items.description: A sweet, lightly sparkling wine with peach, apricot, & honey flavors. Smooth & fruity, it pairs well with Italian desserts like Tiramisu, Gelato, & Cheesecake.

items.name: Cavicchioli, Lambrusco
items.description: A bubbly, slightly sweet red wine that is served well-chilled & is a godsend in the summer. Pairs well with grilled or cured meats, cheeses, Tiramisu, or dishes that call for a light-hearted wine. Great for guests that are beginning their wine journey!
